subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about recovering lapsed and churned subscribers for {Brand} in the window between trial and renewal. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the reactivated paid subscription confirmed through server-side receipt validation, then hold the recovered cohort to 58% D90 retention, so you are paying for renewing members rather than a one-off app reopen. If it helps, I can share the onboarding-to-renewal recovery view for your funnel. Worth a quick look?
illustrative_flags: 58% D90 retention (MobUpps recovered-cohort quality signal, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN health_and_fitness: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof point (reactivated paid subscription validated server-side + recovered-cohort quality); one illustrative MobUpps figure (58% D90); soft CTA with one question mark; native US English register; no sign-off; no X-not-Y comma-negation; no em dash.
